description: SL Verkehrsnetze OKSTRA - Verkehrsnetz - OGC API Features is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This service provides data implemented from the OKSTRA data model for the INSPIRE transport network theme.:A collection of network elements belonging to a single mode of transport. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE-WFS SL Transport Networks OKSTRA - Transport Network - OGC API Features" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include INSPIRE-WFS_SL_OKSTRA, opendata, Saarland, OKSTRA, Geofachdaten, Landesbetrieb für Straßenbau. The listing shows 2025-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
